name: usdt
description: **USDT is an independently issued BEP-20 token deployed on BNB Smart Chain (BSC) with 18 decimal places. It is not issued by, affiliated with, or backed by Tether Limited and is not the official Tether USD₮ stablecoin. Unlike Tether USD₮, which commonly uses 6 decimals on BNB Smart Chain, this token uses 18 decimals.**
